fact: The Blade Bazaar is a sprawling marketplace in Gracklstugh named for the abundance of duergar weaponry, though it sells nearly all traveler needs.
source_quote: a sprawling marketplace named for the most abundant goods the duergar offered, though its stalls sold nearly everything a traveler could need
subject: Blade Bazaar

fact: The party enters the Blade Bazaar, a crowded marketplace filled with various races and the din of commerce.
source_quote: The party made their way to the Blade Bazaar, a sprawling marketplace... The party enters the Blade Bazaar, a crowded marketplace filled with various races and the din of commerce.
subject: party arrives at Blade Bazaar

fact: People in the Blade Bazaar argue mostly in Dwarvish.
source_quote: People argue mostly in Dwarvish
subject: Blade Bazaar

fact: The crowds in the Blade Bazaar offer a chance to slip away from pursuers.
source_quote: offer a good chance to slip away from pursuers
subject: Blade Bazaar

fact: All kinds of non-magical weapons, armor, and shields are available in the Blade Bazaar.
source_quote: All kinds of non-magical weapons, armor and shields are available
subject: Blade Bazaar

fact: Healing potions can be bought in the Darklake district.
source_quote: Healing potions can also be bought in the Darklake district
subject: Darklake district

fact: Powerful magic items are not sold at the Blade Bazaar.
source_quote: but powerful magic items are not sold at the bazaar
subject: Blade Bazaar

fact: Dulgir is a duergar merchant who hurls insults at customers until they show interest in buying.
source_quote: Gyrgum approached a merchant who hurled insults at every customer until he realized they intended to buy
subject: Dulgir

fact: Dulgir curses Gyrgum to the seven heavens before realizing Gyrgum intends to buy.
source_quote: curses Gyrgum "to the seven heavens" until he learns Gyrgum is buying
subject: Dulgir

fact: Dulgir switches to a formal and pompous duergar accent sounding like the Queen's English once he knows Gyrgum is buying.
source_quote: then switches to "a formal and pomp posh duergar accent that eerily sounds like something like the Queen's English"
subject: Dulgir's accent shift

fact: Gyrgum trades his old short sword for a ten percent discount on a new mace from Dulgir.
source_quote: offered a ten percent discount on a new mace in exchange for Gyrgum's "rubbish" old short sword
subject: Gyrgum's purchase

fact: Gyrgum acquires a new mace from Dulgir.
source_quote: offered a ten percent discount on a new mace
subject: new mace

fact: Gyrgum buys a hand axe and a light crossbow without trade-ins.
source_quote: Gyrgum also buys a hand axe with no trade-in, and picks up a light crossbow
subject: Gyrgum's additional purchases

fact: Gyrgum buys a hand axe from Dulgir.
source_quote: Gyrgum also buys a hand axe
subject: hand axe

fact: Gyrgum picks up a light crossbow from Dulgir.
source_quote: picks up a light crossbow
subject: light crossbow (Gyrgum)

fact: Daz expresses interest in finding a magical light crossbow imbued with a spell.
source_quote: Daz expresses interest in finding a magical light crossbow imbued with a spell to aid his accuracy
subject: Daz

fact: Daz hoped to enchant a crossbow with True Strike for advantage on attacks, but such items are not sold in the bazaar.
source_quote: He hoped to enchant it with True Strike for advantage on attacks. The GM says nothing like that is sold in the bazaar.
subject: Daz's True Strike crossbow

fact: Daz decides against buying any equipment, stating he needs to level up before upgrades make sense.
source_quote: Daz decides against buying anything: "I'm happy with what I have and I need to level up before anything makes sense."
subject: Daz's decision

fact: Daz already carries a light crossbow picked up on the road.
source_quote: He already carries a light crossbow picked up on the road
subject: light crossbow (Daz)

fact: Heavy armor is available in the Darklake district.
source_quote: heavy armor, which the GM confirms is available in the Darklake district
subject: Darklake district

fact: Thorin settles on darts as his ranged weapon after confirming the game isn't using pistols.
source_quote: Thorin later settles on darts as his ranged weapon after confirming the game isn't using pistols
subject: Thorin's weapon choice

fact: Zalthir recalls a mysterious list of names he found while cleaning.
source_quote: Zalthir recalled a mysterious list of names he had found while cleaning
subject: list of names

fact: The individuals on Zalthir's list have a connection to the people held as slaves by the drow.
source_quote: The individuals on it had some connection to the people held as slaves by the drow
subject: list of names connection

fact: It is unclear whether the individuals on the list are slavers or worried family members.
source_quote: though whether they were slavers or worried family members was unclear
subject: list of names ambiguity

fact: One name on the list corresponds to someone in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: and one name corresponded to someone in Gracklstugh
subject: Gracklstugh contact

fact: The GM explains the people on the list might care about the slaves, but it is uncertain if they supplied the slaves or care about missing family.
source_quote: The GM explains that the people on the list "might be people that care about the people who are trapped as slaves by the drow."
subject: drow slave trade contacts

fact: The party is advised to be cautious about announcing they are escaped captives of the drow, as it could put a price on their heads.
source_quote: knowing that revealing themselves as escaped captives of the drow could put a price on their heads
subject: risk of exposure

fact: The party has six traveling companions waiting in the district.
source_quote: the GM asks what the party tells its six traveling companions. They are happy to wait in the district.
subject: traveling companions

fact: Hemeth is willing to keep quiet while waiting.
source_quote: Hemeth is willing to keep quiet
subject: Hemeth

fact: Buppido is eager to leave.
source_quote: Buppido is eager to leave
subject: Buppido

fact: Brannum Redmarch is a duergar captive who previously plotted against the party.
source_quote: their captive, Brannum Redmarch, a duergar who had previously plotted against them
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: The party offers Brannum Redmarch his freedom in exchange for using his underworld connections to procure uncommon magical goods.
source_quote: They offered him his freedom in exchange for using his underworld connections to procure uncommon magical goods
subject: Brannum's deal offer

fact: Brannum eagerly agrees to the deal.
source_quote: Brannum eagerly agreed
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: Gyrgum notes that swift duergar justice gives them leverage over Brannum.
source_quote: Gyrgum notes that swift duergar justice gives them leverage over Brannum
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Brannum expresses fear of being turned into the Duergar by the party.
source_quote: Brannum: "you wouldn't turn me into the Duergar."
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: Gyrgum assures Brannum they would not turn him in if he helps them.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "Certainly not if you were to help us out here."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Brannum agrees to help the party acquire uncommon magical items in exchange for his freedom and the clearing of his debts.
source_quote: Brannum agrees to help the party acquire uncommon magical items in exchange for his freedom and the clearing of his debts.
subject: Brannum's agreement

fact: Brannum insists that deals be done as a free exchange of goods and services, not under duress.
source_quote: Brannum insists the deals be "done within the context of a free exchange of goods and services and not under duress."
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: Thorin replies to Brannum that his position is not well understood yet.
source_quote: Thorin replies that "your position is not well understood quite yet"
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum adds that the quid is pro in response to Brannum's insistence on free exchange.
source_quote: Gyrgum adds, "The quid is pro."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Hemeth is offended by the party negotiating with Brannum instead of him.
source_quote: Hemeth, deeply offended at being passed over, insisted on offering his own superior wares at a discount
subject: Hemeth

fact: Hemeth boasts his handaxes are so well-made they would be easily reused by whoever killed their owner.
source_quote: boasting that his handaxes were so well-made they would be easily reused by whoever killed their owner
subject: Hemeth's sales pitch

fact: Hemeth insults the other merchants as crusty old fools.
source_quote: Hemeth: "And why are you buying weapons from those crusty old fools who couldn't sell you? I have the good stuff."
subject: Hemeth

fact: Hemeth criticizes Gyrgum's new purchases as second-hand material lacking fine craftsmanship.
source_quote: Hemeth... examines Gyrgum's new purchases: "this is second-hand material… This lacks the fine craftsmanships that my suppliers provide me."
subject: Hemeth

fact: Brannum protests that he can get items Hemeth cannot, dismissing Hemeth as just a merchant of weapons.
source_quote: Brannum protests: "I thought we had a deal… I could get you things that he can't get. He is just a merchant of weapons."
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: Uncommon magic items need to be named specifically; a +1 weapon is something Hemeth could get himself.
source_quote: A +1 weapon is something Hemeth could get himself. Uncommon magic items need to be named specifically.
subject: Uncommon magic items

fact: Zalthir expresses interest in acquiring an Eldritch Claw tattoo.
source_quote: Zalthir expresses interest in acquiring an Eldritch Claw tattoo, an uncommon magical item
subject: Eldritch Claw tattoo

fact: Zalthir reasons that while monks don't use weapons, they get tattoos.
source_quote: Zalthir's reasoning: "Monks don't really get to use weapons, but we get tattoos."
subject: Zalthir

fact: Brannum claims he may know a contact who can procure the Eldritch Claw tattoo and requests two days.
source_quote: Brannum claims he may know a contact who can procure it, requesting two days
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: Brannum's contact says he may know a guy who may know a guy, asking for two days.
source_quote: The contact's answer: "I may know a guy who may know a guy who may know something. Give me two days."
subject: Brannum's contact

fact: The party can shake its pursuers in the city for now.
source_quote: The party can shake its pursuers in the city for now.
subject: pursuers

source_quote: Gyrgum purchases scrolls of Detect Magic and Identify from a merchant who punctuates his sales pitch with sudden, violent threats

fact: Gyrgum acquires a scroll of Detect Magic.
source_quote: purchases scrolls of Detect Magic and Identify

source_quote: purchases scrolls of Detect Magic and Identify
subject: scroll of Identify

source_quote: In the GM's telling, he says "I'm going to rip your ear" mid-conversation, then carries on normally.
subject: merchant's threat

fact: The scroll merchant punctuates his sales pitch with sudden, violent threats.
source_quote: purchases scrolls of Detect Magic and Identify from a merchant who punctuates his sales pitch with sudden, violent threats before continuing as if nothing happened

fact: Gyrgum puts his hand on his weapon in response to the merchant's threat.
source_quote: Gyrgum puts his hand on his weapon
